traits.note: Jepson's Manual of the Flowering Plants of California (1925), read in full: calyx-tube campanulate, more or less adnate to the ovary; ovary partly or wholly inferior, 5-celled; styles 5, united below; stamens indefinite, about 20. The Burke Herbarium (as quoted in search results; the page itself was not read) gives stamens 12 to 20 and an inferior ovary.
